Description: A canvas tent sags under a thick blanket of mold, but the fire pit beside it is still warm. Racks of sample jars line a fallen log, each labeled in a cramped hand. A half-finished journal lies open: "It is not a disease. It is a conversation, and we have been answering badly."

Replies.SsText: The embers still hold enough heat to cook a meal. You rest more easily than you have in days.
The labels make sense once you recognize the system. You learn how the spores spread and how to avoid them.
Replies.FlText: You open the wrong jar and the contents spray across your face.

Replies.ReplyText: Brew a tonic from the samples.
Replies.SsText: The mixture steams, turns clear, and tastes of mint. It restores you almost at once.
Replies.FlText: The tonic curdles. You drink it anyway and regret it.
